      "status_note": "",

      "fix_pushed": false,

      "status_note": "sedited clarified and reiterated suggestion to use helper functions/structs to collapse boilerplate",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4347194712"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4480175455",
      "status_by_quote": "That said, I think some helper functions/structs to collapse the boiler plate would still be good."
